scripts.build:all: pnpm run clean:build && pnpm --filter @understand-code/contracts --fail-if-no-match build && pnpm --filter @understand-code/core --fail-if-no-match build && pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @understand-code/dashboard --fail-if-no-match build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @understand-code/contracts --fail-if-no-match build && pnpm --filter @understand-code/core --fail-if-no-match build && pnpm --filter @understand-code/contracts --fail-if-no-match exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm run typecheck:skill && pnpm --filter @understand-code/core --fail-if-no-match exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @understand-code/dashboard --fail-if-no-match exec tsc -b --pretty false
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @understand-code/contracts --fail-if-no-match build && pnpm --filter @understand-code/core --fail-if-no-match build && pnpm --filter @understand-code/contracts --fail-if-no-match test && pnpm run test:skill && pnpm --filter @understand-code/core --fail-if-no-match test && pnpm --filter @understand-code/dashboard --fail-if-no-match test
scripts.quality: pnpm run build:all && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
